description: Vue exécutive consolidée des 8 pays et 4 lignes de métier (Banque, Assurance, Mobile Money, Microfinance)

charts.slice_name: Revenus Consolidés par Pays et Ligne Métier
charts.query: SELECT country_code, entity_type, SUM(total_amount_eur) AS total_amount_eur FROM iceberg.gold.daily_transaction_volume GROUP BY country_code, entity_type

charts.slice_name: Évolution Mensuelle de l'ARPC (Revenu Moyen Par Client)
charts.query: SELECT month_year, customer_segment, AVG(arpu_eur) AS arpu_eur FROM iceberg.gold.customer_arpu_monthly GROUP BY month_year, customer_segment ORDER BY month_year

charts.slice_name: Carte Choroplèthe de l'Afrique de l'Ouest (Contribution Revenus)
charts.query: SELECT country_code, SUM(total_amount_eur) AS total_amount_eur FROM iceberg.gold.daily_transaction_volume GROUP BY country_code

charts.slice_name: Top 10 des Produits les Plus Souscrits par Pays
charts.query: SELECT country_code, name AS product_name, entity_type, COUNT(*) AS count__subscriptions FROM iceberg.bronze.products JOIN iceberg.bronze.accounts ON 1=1 GROUP BY country_code, name, entity_type ORDER BY count__subscriptions DESC LIMIT 10
